Selected Work uses row-paired evidence reveal: label and thumbnail stay close together, then claim and year close each record, avoiding orphaned labels during first visit. About route now uses a real handoff: the side-panel bio collapses first, then stage paragraphs enter with deferred keyframe prose motion. Route swaps use a 90ms swap delay, and case headings begin immediately on route navigation with faster opacity and slower physical settling to avoid a blank stage between pages. Case hero remains fade-only; mobile case intro reveal begins after the hero resolves. Case scroll reveals remain role-specific: prose child drift, metadata row construction, lateral section heading entry, opacity-only captions, and layout-aware media scale/clip/radius. Lightbox inspection has an explicit opening state instead of popping in. Mobile drawer closes as an opaque white sliding surface.
